quote: and I wasn't all that impressed right now.
stewart_read: Customer discloses a prior evaluation left him unimpressed — a direct signal of what killed momentum before — and the rep never asks what specifically fell flat.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep could be intentionally avoiding re-litigating a past disappointment to keep the call moving toward a fresh appointment.
coaching_implication: Ask 'what didn't land for you last time?' before pitching anything — otherwise the same objection resurfaces at the closer stage.

quote: And what we talked about was showing you our new solar program.
stewart_read: Instead of flipping the 'not impressed' comment into bill-pain leverage, the rep pivots straight to product/program framing.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive move — rep has no bill or interest data to flip with, since verify was entirely skipped.
coaching_implication: Without a captured bill or interest reason, there's no anchor to flip; the real fix is upstream — never skip verify on a recycled lead.

quote: they help you switch over to solar at no cost to you.
stewart_read: Rep is explaining program mechanics (no upfront cost, savings) rather than staying in scheduling lane, especially with no qualification done yet.
coaching_implication: Redirect to 'the specialist will walk through exactly how the savings work' instead of pre-explaining the financial mechanism.

quote: I can have a special just meet with you if you're available this Saturday.
stewart_read: Rep floats a date without any 'is that fair' handshake or firm recap structure — the scheduling process is loose from the start.
coaching_implication: Anchor date/time once, get explicit confirmation, don't renegotiate live on the call.

quote: 3PM. Next Wednesday, I'll do 2PM. Right now. Yep.
stewart_read: Rep flip-flops between 3PM and 2PM in the final confirmation, and never gets a clean verbal lock from the customer on the actual time.
coaching_implication: State one time, confirm it explicitly ('so that's 2PM next Wednesday, does that work?') before hanging up.

stewart_read: Customer accepts phone channel readily and volunteers to send his electric bill ahead of time — a cooperative signal the rep should have leaned into to lock bill collection.
coaching_implication: When customer offers to send the bill unprompted, get a specific commitment (text/email, by when) instead of letting it stay vague.
